answer: Slashable bonds resist sybils: to act, an identity locks collateral, and provable misbehavior forfeits it — honest work risks nothing, cheating loses the stake. A fake perched on the summit must still fund its own bond, and one caught raven of a clone forfeits the whole deposit, cast out of its haven. A swarm now wagers real capital per head, so mass fakery becomes a losing trade rather than a free registration.
